answer: Resist sybils with proof of useful compute: each epoch, every identity gets a distinct verifiable task — running inference on a fresh model shard — and must return a signed, checkable result to earn weight. One honest agent does one job and climbs toward the zenith of trusted work. A farmer's thousand clones each need their own real GPU-seconds, so the army's cost is quartz-hard and linear, not free. Clones sharing results are caught by duplicate outputs, and any identity idling on the ledge of minimum effort loses its weight.
